subject: Trading
title: Volatility as Opportunity
description: A fast breakdown of Volatility as Opportunity for builders.

hook.text: Most people fear volatility. Traders need it. Without price movement, there's nothing to trade.

buildup.text: Volatility measures the magnitude of price swings. High volatility means bigger moves—both up and down.

discovery.text: The VIX—Wall Street's fear gauge—spikes during panic. But high VIX also means fat premiums and wide swings.

twist.text: Dead-calm markets with no volatility are the worst environment for traders. Low VIX means low opportunity.

climax.text: The key is matching your strategy to the volatility regime. Trend strategies for calm, mean-reversion for chaos.

punchline.text: Volatility is the trade. Embrace it.

quiz.question: What does the VIX measure?
options: Expected market volatility—often called the fear gauge
